## Fixed

- **Icon packs apply.** With "Enforce themed icons" ever switched on, the chosen icon pack was ignored completely, even with themed icons off. With themed icons on, each pack icon was swapped for the app's own themed icon, so the pack looked like it did nothing. The pack's icons now always show; with themed icons on they show in the themed colours.
- **Themed icons stay themed after the screen is locked.** Icons that come back plain are made again when you return to the home screen, and every saved icon is rebuilt once after this update.
- **App closing animation can be seen.** It ran while Android was still shrinking the closing app over the home screen, so it was finished before the home screen showed. It now waits for that, then fades the home screen in ("Fade in") or shrinks away ("Suck in").
